text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —Are you truly serious about this?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes...! I have prepared my resolve.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm!
Then... no holding back, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
All righty! Lesson 1♡
Copy Karen! Facial muscle
training time~♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: L-Like this, perhaps...?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Lesson 2. Research is essential.
Please direct your attention to the plushie show over there~.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ! The host lowers her gaze to match their eye level when speaking... I see.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Lesson 3!
Simulation training to handle any request that comes your way!

text_block_list.name: Acting Fan Girl
text_block_list.text:
"Yayyy, it's Yaeno-oneesan~~♪
Hey, hey, give me a big hug~!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: O-Oss...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You did well to keep up this far.
There is nothing left for us to teach you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am truly grateful for your guidance!
Thanks to you three, tomorrow I should be able to deliver—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Exemplary fan service...!

Passing by the academy stage,
I saw a meet-and-greet event between
Yaeno Muteki and local children underway.

text_block_list.name: Little Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, take a photo with me~!
Do a cool pose like when you broke those tiles!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Gladly.
Would a pose like this suffice?
choice_data_list: (She really gives off that dependable big-sister vibe~)

text_block_list.name: Shy Girl
text_block_list.text: U-Um! Yaeno-oneesan... er...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Take your time, it is quite all right.
I am listening attentively.

text_block_list.name: Shy Girl
text_block_list.text: Um... I... I really, really like you!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—...Ngh... Is that, so.
Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Little Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! Me too, me too!
I wanna talk to my favorite onee-chan too~~!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...P-Please do not rush.
One by one, we shall talk in turn...!

As the meet-and-greet concluded,
Yaeno Muteki saw the children off.
However, the moment they left her sight...

Worried, I hurriedly followed after her.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: THEY ARE TOO ADORABLE!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of them looked up to me with such fond adoration...!!
Ah... how... how...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Precious...!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Kgh... After all that rigorous training...
To think I could barely keep my composure... But—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I must protect those smiles at all costs!

...Out of respect for her impassioned soul-baring shouts,
I quietly stepped away from the scene.
